sourceChecks.title: Induction of immune tolerance in living related human leukocyte antigen-matched kidney transplantation: A phase 3 randomized clinical trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: Fifteen (75%) reached the primary study endpoint of IS-free for >2 years.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: In a phase 3 trial of 20 treated HLA-matched living-sibling kidney recipients using conditioning and donor-derived MDR-101, 19 stopped immunosuppression near one year and 15 remained off it for over two years; four resumed treatment.
sourceChecks.limitations: Small, selected kidney-transplant cohort; multi-step conditioning and cell infusion rather than proven universal one-time procedure; follow-up does not establish lifetime safety or no infection/cancer risk.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: phase 3 trial donor specific immune tolerance living related HLA matched kidney transplantation MDR-101 2025

sourceChecks.title: Intra-Operative Bioprinting of Hard, Soft, and Hard/Soft Composite Tissues for Craniomaxillofacial Reconstruction

sourceChecks.limitations: Animal proof of concept; not minimally invasive human-scale, innervated vascularized functional replacement tissue or full reconstruction of large defects; no clinical outcomes.
